answer: Nothing unlocks before a cliff of 6 epochs, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. Because the whisper cliff is fixed at deposit and recorded in the signal ledger, the juniper audit shows how much each key had accrued when it was cut. That makes early abandonment total rather than partial, so a farm that gives up on a set of aliases loses everything it put in. The fee repeats 23 times over. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
